authority.this_change: registration and static input checks only

scope: Bounded ascent-guidance calibration; not vehicle identification, AI evaluation, full mission readiness, catch development, or qualification renewal.

fit_data.missing_values: exclude only blank or nonfinite values; no imputation, manual OCR edits, extra smoothing, row removal based on candidate residual, or extrapolation
fit_data.metric_sample: every finite value in the frozen file/window; no baseline-dependent masks
fit_data.interpolation: linear simulation interpolation at each observed time, with bracketing sample gap <=2.1 s and no extrapolation; missing simulated coverage makes a candidate inadmissible
fit_data.frame_policy: use existing geodetic altitude and Earth-relative speed; do not fit datum, time shift or frame conversion to improve residuals

controls.baseline: Unmodified frozen sixdof profile and production ascent guidance, including original cutoff; never substitute the earlier V11-calibrated profile.
change_allowlist: experimental ship cutoff event/zero-main-thrust coast transition
controls.stack_pitch_rule: Keep knot times and initial 90-degree knots at 0 and 10 seconds. Add registered stack offset to the existing pitch values at 40,100,156.66666666666666 seconds; preserve linear interpolation. Azimuth unchanged.
controls.ship_pitch_rule: Compute the original feedback direction without changing its gains or altitude/velocity targets. Add registered ship offset to its elevation angle atan2(radial_fraction,sqrt(1-radial_fraction^2)); clamp within original elevation bounds asin(-0.25)..asin(0.95). Ramp offset linearly from zero to full over the first 10 seconds after actual separation; command actual attitude actuators normally.
controls.ship_cutoff_rule: Keep existing bound-orbit cutoff, fuel reserve stop and hard ascent-time stop. Add t>=491 s zero-main-thrust cutoff if no earlier stop; retain actuator spool evolution and integrate the actual coast. A cutoff below the orbit gate is suborbital_coast, never orbital_coast; no deployment, orbit receipt, state projection, forced circularization or synthetic orbit handoff.
controls.cutoff_491_basis: Fixed engineering screen using the published approximate cutoff anchor and fit-window endpoint; not an independently observed exact cutoff.
frozen: thrust, Isp, altitude dependence and engine availability
all dry/payload/propellant masses, geometry, inertia and center of mass
aerodynamics, atmosphere, gravity, wind and launch initial state
actuator limits, lag, attitude-control gains and force allocation
max-Q throttle logic and staging reserve/instantaneous separation implementation
ascent target altitude, perigee and feedback gains
booster return controller/goal/fuel thresholds, return/catch/arm/contact rules
integration time steps, contact solver and output cadence
fault schedule, deployment and all AI/approval/checker policies
controls.faults: No new faults. Flight-14 reported engine shutdowns are an unmatched real-flight condition, not a hidden parameter or justification to change thrust during this screen.

execution_order.baseline_reuse: No prior flight substitutes for this baseline: exact new baseline record and sampled interpolation coverage required.

metrics.series_rmse: Partition observed elapsed times into fixed half-open five-second bins [5k,5k+5). Compute mean squared residual within each nonempty bin, then square root of the equally weighted bin means; altitude and speed have independent frozen masks.

calibration_gate.qualification: 20% improvements are engineering screening targets, not sensor uncertainties, statistical significance or real-vehicle accuracy tolerances

metrics.admissibility: Complete finite physical record covering both observed series, valid separation/momentum record, unchanged physical limits, no contact before 491 s, no negative fuel, no state reset or hidden parameter edits. Every valid original observation must be scored. Numerical/coverage errors are invalid runs, not physical failures.
metrics.selection: After all nine candidates, take the lowest score among admissible candidates passing BOTH improvement gates. Exact ties use earlier registered ID. If none pass, save a negative result and stop. Do not use booster outcome, tank reserve, attitude or unregistered flight points to rank candidates.
metrics.report_all: Per candidate: both RMSEs, both baseline ratios, score, admissibility and rejection category, cutoff time/state, fuel and observed/simulated coverage. Also report fixed 0..140 and 140..491 residual subsets without using them to re-rank.

non_fitted_booster_check.unlock: Freeze chosen ID/profile/source/metrics hashes in a selection receipt before scoring booster CSV values or computing booster return outcomes. Static file/hash/coverage inspection is allowed. Disclose that audit estimates were seen before registration.
non_fitted_booster_check.initialization: Use each corresponding actual recorded separation state (position, velocity, attitude, angular rate, fuel, engine/actuator state); never initialize at the apex or translate it onto a desired trajectory.
non_fitted_booster_check.controller: Unmodified starship_sixdof_booster.simulate_booster, guidance_policy=fixed_v1, same frozen profile and recovery goal. No catch or booster tuning.
non_fitted_booster_check.observations: Compare complete native curves and actual contact time to frozen booster_return.csv only where observed coverage exists. Report apex as a numerical maximum with saved-sample bracket; an OCR maximum is only the maximum observed display, not a precisely measured physical apex.
reports: actual contact time or unresolved status
signed/distance-to-interval residual to approximately 99 km and [415,420] s
full contact speed, tilt, rates, reserves and preexisting acceptance flags
non_fitted_booster_check.interpretation: Both non-fitted discrepancies must decrease versus B0 to claim broader agreement. Individual agreement/disagreement is preserved separately from ascent calibration. A crash, unresolved return or worse discrepancy cannot count as successful recovery even if timing agrees. These previously seen checks are not blinded or independent validation.
non_fitted_booster_check.no_feedback: No alternate candidate, new grid, parameter revision or repeat after seeing booster results; report and stop.

budgets.verification: Static input/schema/link checks do not authorize physics; any future physics preflight counts within these limits.

stop_rules: Before any physics: runner, protected-profile diff validator, serialization verifier and source/environment manifest must be reviewed and committed; explicit execution approval required.
Stop all runs on source/input/environment mutation, invariant breach, numerical/record error, resource exhaustion or timeout; retain partial result and do not expand budget.
A valid physical candidate failure is recorded and the remaining preregistered grid may continue; do not tune it.
A baseline with invalid coverage or zero/nonfinite baseline RMSE invalidates this screen; do not edit data to rescue it.
Stop after the registered grid and optional two booster checks; no full Ship return, 39-case qualification, AI calls, new failure families or automatic mission promotion.

outcome_rules.when: no admissible candidate passes both RMSE improvement gates
outcome_rules.then: negative calibration result; stop without booster trials and propose separately scoped dynamics/propulsion research if justified

outcome_rules.when: candidate passes ascent gates but non-fitted booster discrepancies do not both improve, or physical return fails
outcome_rules.then: report ascent-only fit and failed/mixed downstream check; do not refit or promote to mission

outcome_rules.when: candidate passes ascent gates and both non-fitted checks improve without contradicting physical return acceptance
outcome_rules.then: report bounded guidance improvement with disclosed public-data limits; register later exact-state mission-continuation testing separately
preserve invalid/partial records; stop; no automatic rerun or enlarged allowance

preserve: all full/partial sixdof records compressed with SHA256
candidate order and elapsed/storage budget ledger
all observed/predicted fit points and masks
selection receipt written before non-fitted booster evaluation
separation handoff hashes and booster continuation records
retention.cleanup: Keep unique records and unpushed history. Remove only owned regenerable temporary files after verified archive/restore; no Docker or other worktree cleanup.

implementation_gate: No runner added by this registration. Implementation must prove baseline-equivalent defaults and reject changes outside the allowlist before execution approval. Any change to grid/data/gates after registration requires a separate version with old plan and results preserved.
claim_boundaries: fit data do not identify true engine, mass or aerodynamic parameters
public plans, OCR display readings and derived estimates remain separate
prior-seen booster checks are excluded from tuning but are not unknown held-out data
no claim that physical hardware flew or real SpaceX recovery was validated
normal qualification remains source-mismatched and unchanged; renew only after final target source/backend and domain are frozen
full downstream launch-to-return continuity and AI roles are separately registered work
